create_vertex_url: create a Vertex AI URL for partner models like Llama, Mistral, AI21, or Claude with streaming support
build_complete_vertex_url: build a complete Vertex AI API URL resolving region, api_base, and partner model endpoint
load_vertex_auth: load Vertex AI authentication credentials from JSON string, dict, or file path with workload identity federation support
get_vertex_access_token: get a valid access token and project ID using cached or freshly loaded Google Cloud credentials
get_vertex_region: get the supported Vertex AI region for a model, defaulting to us-central1 if unsupported
